==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Fusheng:''' If nothing unexpected happens, we will definitely win this war.
:{{DIcon}} Why?
:'''Fusheng:''' After fighting for a lifetime, we can always summarize some battle experience and conclusions.
:'''Fusheng:''' Although everyone is still tense, overall, the [[Midnight Rangers]] will no longer be trapped in a bloody battle like the previous war when facing [[Tacet Discord]].
:{{DIcon}} The previous war?
:'''Fusheng:''' The Battle Beneath the Crescent many years ago... Oh, come to think of it, it's been a long time since I talked to someone about these things.
:'''Fusheng:''' I was young back then, and I had never seen such a battle before...
:'''Fusheng:''' The unstoppable tide of Tacet Discord almost engulfed the entire army, and the comrades in chaos suddenly started killing each other...
:'''Fusheng:''' The endless war slowly dragged each of us into the vortex of weariness, and a moment of relaxation in the mind could take away your life.
:'''Fusheng:''' Countless people fell in that war, even my dear friend who grew up with me was not spared.
:'''Fusheng:''' Those nightmarish days, I can't even distinguish now what was real and what was fake...
:'''Fusheng:''' Those who have experienced that war find it hard to completely move on. I once left the army and lived in the city, but I found that I can only find peace in the barracks.
:'''Fusheng:''' ... I still can't let go of my comrades, whether it's the past or the present, haha.
{{Dialogue End}}
